title: bug: chatWait.test.ts fixture Worker sets epicId: null, which fails the test-file typecheck (TS2322) and so hides real type errors
description: Repro: in a snapshot, scratch tsconfig extends ./tsconfig.json with types:["node"], include only src/tools/chatWait.test.ts, then `npx tsc -p <it>` gives src/tools/chatWait.test.ts(71,7): error TS2322: Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'string' (the worker fixture's `epicId: null`). Present at HEAD, found while gating task-48edc21b. tsconfig.json excludes src/**/*.test.ts, so `npx tsc --noEmit` never sees it.

implementationPlan.description: Prove red, then fix the fixture. (a) Build a gate snapshot with native Linux node_modules. The shared checkout's node_modules is the Windows install, so in WSL `npx tsc` fails 'Unable to resolve @typescript/typescript-linux-x64' and `npx vitest` fails on the rolldown binding (mem:gotcha-linux-vitest-reuse-native-node-modules). Never npm install in the shared checkout. Recipe: `SNAP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-a61d-gate.XXXXXX); git archive HEAD packages/moe-daemon | tar -x -C $SNAP; cp -al <native node_modules> $SNAP/packages/moe-daemon/node_modules`. Pick a non-symlink /tmp/*/repo/packages/moe-daemon/node_modules whose @rolldown/ holds a *linux* binding, which has @typescript/typescript-linux-x64, and whose sibling package-lock.json (CR stripped) has the same md5 as `git show HEAD:packages/moe-daemon/package-lock.json`. At plan time /tmp/moe-4d67-qa.BdSmpP/repo/packages/moe-daemon/node_modules qualified. If none is left, run `npm ci` in a separate scratch copy. (b) RED: in $SNAP/packages/moe-daemon, with every MOE_* env var unset, run the typecheck half of the gate: `npx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --resolveJsonModule --types node src/tools/chatWait.test.ts`. It must print exactly `src/tools/chatWait.test.ts(71,7): error TS2322: Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'string'.` and exit non-zero. Quote that in the step note. (c) FIX, in the shared checkout, only inside the beforeEach `const worker: Worker = {...}` literal (lines 67-80). First, change line 71 `epicId: null,` to `epicId: '',`. Worker.epicId is a plain `string` (src/types/schema.ts:1145), and '' is what joinTeam.ts:76 writes for an epic-less seat, which is what this fixture models. Second, add `teamId: null,` on a new line after `errorCount: 0,`. Worker.teamId is a required `string | null` (schema.ts:1154), and state/workerStore.ts createWorker writes null. The teamId line is required. For an object literal, TS reports only the per-property TS2322, which hides TS2741 `Property 'teamId' is missing ... but required in type 'Worker'`. Fixing epicId alone turns the check red with TS2741 (verified at plan time). The PEER_ID record (`{ ...worker, id: PEER_ID }`) inherits both fields. Change nothing else: no assertions, no other tests, no other files.

Expected result: tsc prints nothing, vitest reports `Test Files  1 passed (1)` and `Tests  29 passed (29)`, and the exit code is 0. 29 is the count at HEAD 4d047c70. It must equal the count before your edit, because the edit adds and removes no test. Submit that command string, its exit code and its output tail as verification. Error handling: the change adds no runtime code and alters no error path; the gate fails closed, because any tsc diagnostic or failing test makes the `&&` chain exit non-zero, and a non-zero exit means fix and rerun, never complete. If no Linux node_modules can be had, the same command can run natively on Windows: `cmd.exe /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\packages\moe-daemon && <command after the cd>"`. Vitest then writes node_modules/.vite in the shared tree, so prefer the snapshot.

(b) epicId 'epic-1', as most other fixtures use. Acceptable, but '' mirrors how joinTeam registers an epic-less chat participant, which is what this fixture models. (c) Fix epicId only. Insufficient: an object literal's TS2322 elaboration hides TS2741 for the missing required teamId, which a scratch probe confirmed. (d) Also fix the identical chatChannelRef.test.ts:76 fixture and util/workerRole.test.ts:17, or add a CI test-file typecheck.
